summary: Swift research program convergence: fix held-out round 2 findings and refused halves by file owner, then held-out round 3 on three fresh trees

fixes.unit: swift-quality checks and rules (rules/swift-quality.md, checks/*, language.md, concurrency.md, apple.md, api-design.md)
applied: NEW class (a), k07.sh: judges each scan by exit status (grep 2, xargs 123, git 128) instead of non-empty stderr. Each entry runs through a scan() wrapper, pipe filters are awk so pipefail keeps grep's status, and hatches() writes the git ls-files list to a temp file so its status is seen. stderr stays visible. On a twin with a symlinked .gitignore beside a subdirectory the old script exited 1 with no violation line and the new one exits 0 with the git warning shown. It is still red on a planted try!, on an unreadable file and in a non-git directory. vapor/jwt-kit now prints its 7 real hits. swift-prometheus output is identical to before. Header and SW-CORE-06 row updated. Sweep of every checks/ script and every cell in my files: k07.sh was the only one judging by stderr presence.

Finding 1, swiftlint-gate.sh: 'but configuration specified version' in the log now exits 70 with a FAIL line. SwiftGen's pinned 0.48.0 exited 2 before and exits 70 now. A pinned clean twin exits 70, the unpinned twin 0, an unpinned violating file 2.

Findings 2, 18, 19, weaken-check.sh: the pathspec now covers *.toml, *.rake, *.mk, *.service, *akefile*, *[Jj]ustfile, *Dockerfile*, *Containerfile* and .env files. A removed treatWarning, treatAllWarnings or strictMemorySafety line counts in Package*.swift. A feature commit removing gate steps from rakelib/gate.rake, GNUmakefile, justfile and Rakefile.gate, plus the manifest gates, printed nothing before and prints every removed line now. enable=no in Dockerfile.ci, Containerfile, .env and app.service printed nothing before and prints all four now. Twins and a removed -Werror comment in a non-manifest .swift stay silent. Reproduced on a copy of jwt-kit with Package@swift-6.4.swift. The SW-CORE-01 row now says an extensionless script (ci/check) is read by eye.

Finding 20, silence-check.sh: same carrier set as weaken-check.sh. Added clock .sleep(for:/until:), libc sleep and nanosleep, asyncAfter, shell 'sleep N', and an empty catch (one line, or a body of only comments). The plant printed nothing before and prints each form now. The twin is green. SW-CORE-17 row updated.

Finding 3, api-design.md pubenum, proto1 and the SW-API-12 cell, concurrency.md S8/S9/S10 and the git-diff cell at line 168, language.md L02: file lists are now NUL-separated (-print0, -Z, xargs -0). L02 and S8 now print the 'My Dir/Bad.swift' plants. swift-markdown pubenum census went from 10 to 13 enums. Finding 7, language.md T00: it is now a CI-text hint. Finding 26, apple.md: --exclude-dir='.build' added to every operand-dot grep -R (12 cells, including the SW-APPLE-09 inline cell). Planted .build/checkouts hits are gone and a real Sources hit still prints.

Run on the RediStack scratch copy with the rule set installed it printed './.claude/rules/swift-quality/checks/weaken-check.sh:25:# SWIFT_BACKTRACE=enable=no printed all four.' and exited 0, so the pass can never be empty on an installed tree. findings.fix: Add --exclude-dir=.claude --exclude-dir=.agents to the Step 0 grep (match the index backtrace-grep), or state in the skill that .claude lines are the installed rule set.

findings.evidence: Measured on 6.4: SWIFT_BACKTRACE=enable=false, enable=off, enable=0 and color=no,enable=no each cut the planted crash from 54 stderr lines to 13 (backtracer off), same as enable=no. Planted carriers in a scratch repo: backtrace-grep/Step 0 print only Dockerfile.1 (enable=no), ci.yml and 'enable=no,color=no'; they miss enable=false/off/0, 'color=no,enable=no', app.Dockerfile (glob is Dockerfile*), justfile, mise.toml, prod.env (.env* needs a leading dot) and devcontainer.json. weaken-check prints 7 of 11 planted carriers: it misses the same four value variants and the JSON form (a quote sits between the name and ':'), and it prints the '# SWIFT_BACKTRACE=enable=no' comment-only line.
findings.fix: Match 'SWIFT_BACKTRACE[^\n]*enable[=: "]*(no|false|off|0)\b' (value alternatives, any position in the comma list), allow an optional quote before [=:], and widen carriers to *Dockerfile*, *.env, .env*, justfile/Justfile, *.toml, *.json. Skip lines whose first non-space char is '#'.

findings.evidence: Index done-gate step 5 (L49) reads 'if swift package plugin --list | grep -q generate-documentation; then DOCC=1 ...'. gates.md L59 says the DOCC=1 before --list matters because the plugin is declared only under that variable. Plant: manifest adds swift-docc-plugin only when ProcessInfo environment DOCC == "1". Index form prints count 0 and takes the 'SKIP 5: no docc plugin declared' branch with exit 0; DOCC=1 swift package plugin --list lists generate-documentation. The two copies of the gate disagree and the index copy silently skips DocC on the manifest shape the rule itself describes.
findings.fix: Put DOCC=1 before 'swift package plugin --list' in the index copy so it is byte-identical to gates.md L59.

findings.evidence: sw-test-01 (and the sw-test-03 and sw-test-18 added-line forms) diff 'origin/main...HEAD': committed changes only. A new untracked Tests/FooTests.swift with 'import XCTest' and an uncommitted edit adding setenv( both print nothing, so empty output reads as pass on a working tree full of violations. The guard line only checks that origin/main resolves.
findings.fix: Use 'git add -N .' then 'git diff --merge-base "$BASE"' (as hatch-delta and pubenum do) so uncommitted and untracked files are in scope.

findings.evidence: pubenum gate form 'git add -N . && git diff --name-only -z ... --merge-base "$BASE" ... | xargs -r -0 perl pubenum.pl' has no BASE guard. With BASE=nonexistent (and on the PromiseKit copy, which has no origin) git prints 'fatal: bad revision' to stderr, xargs -r gets empty input and the pipeline exits 0 with no stdout; with a valid BASE the same plant prints 'public enum Bad lacks @nonexhaustive'. A mistyped or absent base is a silent pass. Sibling forms (testing, hatch-delta, apple) guard with rev-parse --verify.
findings.fix: Prefix the gate with 'git rev-parse --verify -q "${BASE}^{commit}" >/dev/null || { echo "BASE does not resolve" >&2; exit 66; }' and set -o pipefail.

findings.evidence: S1 changed-files line hard-codes origin/main with no resolve guard and no 'git add -N': on PromiseKit it printed 'fatal: bad revision origin/main' and exited 0, and an untracked new file with an undocumented @unchecked Sendable is not listed by plain 'git diff --name-only'.
findings.fix: Use the same guarded 'git add -N . && git diff --merge-base "$BASE"' form as hatch-delta.

findings.evidence: Pre-tag step runs plain 'git status --porcelain # any output is the finding'. On any tree with the rule set installed it prints '?? .claude/' (measured on PromiseKit and nio-ssh copies), so a clean release tree can never pass. swift-upgrade U0 already uses the ':(exclude).claude' ':(exclude).agents' pathspec after measuring this.
findings.fix: Use git status --porcelain -- . ':(exclude).claude' ':(exclude).agents' as swift-upgrade does.

findings.evidence: Recheck commands L42, L81, L144, L215 use 'swift build --scratch-path .build-tp|.build-isc|.build-ser|.build-tl' inside the tree and never remove them. After the cells ran on nio-ssh and RediStack, git status showed '?? .build-isc/ .build-ser/ .build-tl/ .build-tp/' (trips the U0/U8 clean-tree test), and every '--exclude-dir=.build' grep still scans them: G7 printed './.build-tl/checkouts/swift-nio/.swift-format' and 50 sibling lines as config findings, and whole-tree k07 on a planted '.build-tp/checkouts/dep/Sources/Dep/a.swift' printed the @unchecked Sendable line. The rest of the skill keeps scratch outside the tree ($S/...).
findings.fix: Use --scratch-path "$S/tp" (outside the tree) in all four commands, or rm -rf the directories after the recheck and add them to the cell.

findings.file: rules/swift-quality/language.md (SW-LANG-03 Linux build) and skills/swift-upgrade/SKILL.md U7
findings.new_class: container build shares and pollutes the host .build
findings.evidence: 'docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/src -w /src swift:6.4 swift build' runs as root with the repo as /src and no --scratch-path. Afterwards nio-ssh and PromiseKit .build held root-owned dirs (.build/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu, repositories/*), later non-root cells printed 'find: ./.build/...: Permission denied', and the next host-path build failed with "precompiled file '/src/.build/.../SwiftShims.pcm' was compiled with module cache path '...' ... missing required module 'SwiftShims'" (and the reverse: Stale file ... outside the allowed root paths). U7 passes --scratch-path /tmp/u7 for exactly this reason; SW-LANG-03 and the floor-leg line do not.
findings.fix: Add -u "$(id -u):$(id -g)" and --scratch-path /tmp/lang03 to the docker commands in language.md (build and the 6.2.0 floor test), and say a .build populated by the host cannot be reused by the /src mount.

findings.evidence: U8 says migrate with a Package@swift-X.swift in effect 'edits the dead Package.swift, exits 0 and enables nothing'. Dry-run on PromiseKit (Package.swift tools 4.0 shadowed by Package@swift-5.3.swift on 6.4): 'swift package migrate --target PromiseKit --to-feature ExistentialAny' applied 15 fix-its in 6 source files, then exited 1 with 'Could not update manifest ... (package manifest version 4.0.0 is too old: please update to manifest version 5.8.0 or newer)'; dump-package count was 0. The exit-1 taxonomy lists only 'no edits' and 'unable to find target'; this third form (source edits kept, dead manifest too old) is missing, and the exit-0 claim holds only when the dead manifest is >= 5.8.
findings.fix: Add the 'manifest version X is too old' exit-1 form to the U8 taxonomy and qualify the exit-0 claim by the dead manifest's tools version; keep 'git checkout -- .' as the recovery.

findings.evidence: Row says the flag 'exits 1 on any warning including an ungrouped one (6.4.0)'. On 6.4 the Swift-5-mode warning "passing non-Sendable parameter 'body' to function expecting a '@Sendable' closure" is not promoted: swiftc 6.4 -swift-version 5 -warnings-as-errors exits 0 with the warning (also with -strict-concurrency=targeted), exits 1 only with =complete or -swift-version 6. swift:6.3 turns the same line into 'error:' and exits 1. In the trees: 'swift build -Xswiftc -warnings-as-errors' exits 0 on 6.4 with 4 Sendable warnings on PromiseKit (Box.swift:95,97) and on RediStack (HashCommands.swift:387, tools 6 with swiftLanguageModes [.v5]), while 6.3 would fail. Done-gate steps 2 and 3 and swift-upgrade U7 ('exit 0 on both toolchains') are false green on a Swift 5 mode package on the 6.4 leg.
findings.fix: Narrow the claim to Swift 6 mode (or packages with StrictConcurrency enabled), say 6.4 leaves minimal-checking Sendable warnings as warnings, and make the gate count warning lines (swift build ... 2>&1 | grep -c 'warning:') for mode-5 packages.

findings.evidence: On PromiseKit the first tsan-check.sh run printed nothing for 8+ minutes at 0% CPU: container ps showed 'swift-test --sanitize=thread' alive with a defunct '[CorePromise-tes]' runner, and a direct run of the same command logged 'ThreadSanitizer: CHECK failed: tsan_rtl.cpp:1086'. Two later runs completed (exit 1, real data races at LoggingTests.swift:95). The script has no timeout, buffers all output until exit, and only treats 'FATAL: ThreadSanitizer' (not 'CHECK failed') as 'did not run' (70). One hang in three runs.
findings.fix: Wrap swift test in 'timeout "${TSAN_TIMEOUT:-1200}"' mapping 124 to exit 70, and add 'ThreadSanitizer: CHECK failed' to the exit-70 patterns.

findings.evidence: K1 'grep -RPzo catch\b[^{};]*\{\s*\}' matches the word catch inside a doc comment and runs across lines to the next empty body: on PromiseKit it printed Sources/Catchable.swift 'catch` and `recover` to your object that conforms to `Thenable` ... public protocol CatchMixin: Thenable {}' (a protocol, not a catch clause).
findings.fix: Anchor on a statement start ('^[[:space:]]*(\}[[:space:]]*)?catch\b' with (?m)) and skip lines starting with //, ///, or *.

findings.evidence: The G0 gate is package-level ('any executable target') but every G1 grep scans all of Sources. swift-nio-ssh has sample/benchmark executables (NIOSSHClient, NIOSSHServer, NIOSSHPerformanceTester) beside the NIOSSH library; the block printed 66 lines, including 12 library fatalError lines (G1-03b: AESGCM.swift, SSHChildChannel.swift, CSPRNG.swift, UserAuthenticationMethod.swift) and 'try' lines in the benchmark main.swift.
findings.fix: Scope G1 to the executable targets' directories (list them from dump-package) and apply the NOSHIP excludes (Example*, Demo*, Benchmark*).

findings.evidence: The reserveCapacity alternative prints bounded literals: swift-nio-ssh prints reserveCapacity(1), (8) and (3) (NIOSSHCertifiedPublicKey.swift:711, SSHChannelMultiplexer.swift:47, UserAuthenticationMethod.swift:66) beside the real wire-sized sites (SSHTerminalModes.swift:396, RESPTranslator.swift:255 elementCount).
findings.fix: Drop hits whose argument is an integer literal: pipe through grep -v -E 'reserveCapacity\([0-9_]+\)'.

findings.evidence: The fixed-port alternative '[Pp]ort: *[1-9][0-9]{3,4}' matches protocol-message values that are never bound: swift-nio-ssh prints 15 lines (EndToEndTests.swift '.listen(host: "localhost", port: 8765)', ChildChannelMultiplexerTests originatorAddress port: 8765, SSHMessagesTests firstPort: 65536) from SSH TCP-forwarding request fixtures.
findings.fix: Restrict to bind/connect call shapes (bind(host:port:), ServerBootstrap, .connect(host:) with a real listener) or document the '// literal ok:' escape in the rule row for protocol libraries.

findings.evidence: flag-grep ('-swift-version' in *.yml) prints PromiseKit's .github/workflows/ci.yml:31,57,59 ('swift build -Xswiftc -swift-version -Xswiftc 3|4|4.2'). These are deliberate legacy-language-mode legs on Swift 4.x containers, not a leaked Swift 6 probe, but the rule says empty output is the only pass.
findings.fix: Narrow the pattern to the probe values ('-swift-version[^0-9]*6') or allow a trailing '# legacy-mode leg:' marker.

findings.evidence: T04 and T06 ignore the manifest exclude list and comments. On PromiseKit (Package@swift-5.3.swift excludes AnyPromise.swift and *.m from the Linux target) T04 prints 10 @objc/NSObject lines from AnyPromise.swift that never compile on Linux; T06 prints doc-comment samples (Thenable.swift:26, firstly.swift:8-21) and Documentation/Examples/URLSession+BadResponseErrors.swift, because NOSHIP does not exclude 'Documentation' and the grep does not skip '///' lines. T07/T08 also scan Tests (RediStack ConnectionPoolTests.swift:646).
findings.fix: Say in the row that the hit list must be intersected with the effective manifest's target sources (exclude:), add Documentation to NOSHIP and filter '^[[:space:]]*///'.

findings.evidence: S10 lists any file naming DiscardingTaskGroup with no cap word. RediStack's Sources/RediStack/Cluster/SwiftPolyfill.swift (exit 123) only declares 'protocol DiscardingTaskGroupProtocol' and two conformance extensions; there is no accept loop.
findings.fix: Require a call site (withDiscardingTaskGroup( or withThrowingDiscardingTaskGroup() instead of the bare type name.
